quests.name: Den of Evil
quests.description: Akara of the Rogue Encampment asks you to cleanse a nearby cave overrun by demons. Slay every monster within the Den of Evil to restore Akara's faith in her people.

objectives.description: Slay all monsters in the Den of Evil.

quests.name: Sisters' Burial Grounds
quests.description: Kashya, captain of the Rogues, demands you destroy Blood Raven, a former sister now twisted into a champion of evil who raises the dead in the Burial Grounds.

quests.name: The Search for Cain
quests.description: Find Deckard Cain, the last of the Horadrim. Recover the Scroll of Inifuss in the Dark Wood, give it to Akara, then rescue him at the ruined-village cage in the Dark Wood.

objectives.description: Recover the Scroll of Inifuss from the tree after clearing the Dark Wood.
Rescue Deckard Cain from his cage in the Dark Wood ruined village.

quests.name: The Forgotten Tower
quests.description: A moldy tome speaks of a forgotten tower drowned in evil and gold. Descend the Forgotten Tower and slay the Countess in her bloody chamber.

quests.name: Tools of the Trade
quests.description: Recover Charsi's Horadric Malus from the Catacombs cache and give it to her in the Rogue Encampment.

objectives.description: Recover the Horadric Malus after clearing the Catacombs.
Give the Horadric Malus to Charsi.

quests.name: Sisters to the Slaughter
quests.description: Andariel, the Maiden of Anguish, has corrupted the Rogue Monastery. Descend through the Catacombs and slay her to free the Sisters and reopen the path east.

quests.name: Radament's Lair
quests.description: Atma the tavern keeper begs you to slay Radament, a mummy sheltering in a burial chamber beneath the Far Oasis and preying on Lut Gholein's people.

objectives.description: Slay Radament in the burial chamber beneath the Far Oasis.

quests.name: The Horadric Staff
quests.description: Cain reveals that Tal Rasha's tomb can only be opened with the Horadric Staff. Recover the Cube, the Staff shaft, and the Viper Amulet, then assemble them.

objectives.description: Recover the Horadric Cube from the coffer in the Dry Hills.
Recover the Staff of Kings from the coffer in the Far Oasis.
Recover the Amulet of the Viper from the Serpent Altar in the Lost City.
Combine staff and amulet in the Horadric Cube.

quests.name: The Tainted Sun
quests.description: An eclipse smothers the desert sun, the work of the Claw Vipers reviving their idol. Destroy the Serpent Altar deep within the Claw Viper Temple.

objectives.description: Destroy the Serpent Altar in the Lost City.

quests.name: The Arcane Sanctuary
quests.description: Jerhyn fears the palace cellar holds a portal to Horazon's Arcane Sanctuary. Search it and find the journal that reveals the true Tomb of Tal Rasha.

objectives.description: Read Horazon's journal to identify the true tomb.

quests.name: The Seven Tombs
quests.description: Within the true Tomb of Tal Rasha, Baal's prison hosts the Lord of Pain himself: Duriel. Shatter the orifice with the Horadric Staff and slay him.

objectives.description: Place the Horadric Staff into the orifice in the true Tomb of Tal Rasha.

quests.name: The Golden Bird
quests.description: A jade figurine of a golden bird, looted from Skatsimi monks, can be transmuted into a potion of life. Find it and bring it to Alkor.

objectives.description: Bring the Golden Bird to Alkor.

quests.name: Blade of the Old Religion
quests.description: Hratli the smith asks you to recover the Gidbinn, a sacred blade hidden in the Flayer Jungle, to free the Kurast refugees from fetish slavery.

objectives.description: Recover the Gidbinn from its altar.

quests.name: Khalim's Will
quests.description: To shatter the Compelling Orb that protects Mephisto, you must reassemble Khalim's Will: his Heart, Brain, Eye, and Flail, scattered across Kurast.

objectives.description: Recover Khalim's Flail from the High Council.
Transmute the four parts in the Horadric Cube.

quests.name: Lam Esen's Tome
quests.description: Alkor seeks the Black Book of Lam Esen, hidden somewhere in the temples of Kurast. Recover it and learn its secrets.

objectives.description: Recover the Black Book of Lam Esen.

quests.name: The Guardian
quests.description: Mephisto, Lord of Hatred, awaits in the Durance of Hate beneath Travincal. Strike him down and seal the wound he has torn in the world.

quests.name: The Fallen Angel
quests.description: Izual, the fallen angel who betrayed Heaven, wanders the Plains of Despair as a corrupted shade. Free his tortured soul.

objectives.description: Defeat Izual and free his soul.

quests.name: Hell's Forge
quests.description: Cain bids you destroy Mephisto's Soulstone on the Hellforge. Use Hephasto's hammer to shatter the gem and release a shower of runes and gems.

objectives.description: Shatter the Soulstone on the Hellforge.

quests.name: Terror's End
quests.description: Diablo, Lord of Terror, has manifested in the Chaos Sanctuary. Break the seals, draw him out, and end his reign over the mortal world.

quests.name: Siege on Harrogath
quests.description: Baal's lieutenant Shenk the Overseer drives demons against Harrogath's walls. Break the siege by slaying him on the Bloody Foothills.

quests.name: Rescue on Mount Arreat
quests.description: Demons have captured barbarian warriors in the Frigid Highlands. Free them so they may rejoin Harrogath's defense.

quests.name: Prison of Ice
quests.description: Anya, the elder's daughter, has been frozen by Nihlathak and exiled. Find her, thaw her with Malah's potion, and confront Nihlathak in the Crystalline Passage.

objectives.description: Find Anya in the Crystalline Passage.

quests.name: Rite of Passage
quests.description: To enter the Worldstone Keep, you must complete the Ancients' Rite. Reach the Ancients' Way and defeat Talic, Korlic, and Madawc together.

quests.name: Eve of Destruction
quests.description: Baal, Lord of Destruction, has reached the Worldstone Chamber. End his life before he corrupts the Worldstone forever.

objectives.description: Defeat Baal's five minion waves in the Throne of Destruction.

quests.name: Charsi's Imbue
quests.description: After giving Charsi the Horadric Malus, present an eligible normal weapon or armor unchanged. Claim a separate Imbue charge, then choose which item to imbue.

objectives.description: Present an eligible normal weapon or armor to Charsi without consuming it.

quests.name: Kashya's Recruit
quests.description: After avenging the Sisters at the Burial Grounds, Kashya offers to lend you one of her Rogue Scouts as a mercenary.

objectives.description: Hire a Rogue Scout from Kashya.

quests.name: Cain's Gratitude
quests.description: For rescuing him from the ruined village in the Dark Wood, Cain offers to identify your unidentified items free of charge for the rest of your journey.

objectives.description: Speak with Cain in the Rogue Encampment.

quests.name: Gheed's Gamble
quests.description: The merchant Gheed loves a wager. Spend gold on his gambling stall five times for a chance at a guaranteed magical item.

quests.name: Whispers of the Cow King
quests.description: Stories whisper of a Secret Cow Level. Transmute Wirt's Leg with a Tome of Town Portal in the Horadric Cube to open a moo-ving portal.

objectives.description: Open the Secret Cow Level portal.

quests.name: Greiz's Roster
quests.description: Greiz, captain of the Lut Gholein guard, offers Desert Mercenaries to those who have proven themselves against the sewer dwellers.

objectives.description: Hire a Desert Mercenary from Greiz.

quests.name: Fara's Favor
quests.description: Fara, the former Paladin, will repair your gear at a discount after you've cleansed Radament's filth from the sewers.

quests.name: The Lost Caravan
quests.description: Elzix's caravan was ambushed in the Far Oasis. Recover his strongbox from the bandit camp.

objectives.description: Recover the strongbox in the Far Oasis.

quests.name: Drognan's Tome
quests.description: The sage Drognan asks you to recover a sun-cult tome from the Lost City. He will reward you with a tome of arcane learning.

quests.name: Horazon's Lockbox
quests.description: Rumor speaks of a hidden lockbox left by Horazon in the Arcane Sanctuary. Find it and bring its prize back to Atma.

quests.name: Asheara's Iron Wolves
quests.description: Asheara, captain of the Iron Wolves, offers her elemental mages as mercenaries to those willing to brave the Kurast jungle.

objectives.description: Hire an Iron Wolf from Asheara.

quests.name: Alkor's Experiment
quests.description: Alkor wants ingredients from a giant spider in the Spider Cavern for his alchemical experiments. Bring him fresh venom glands.

quests.name: Jade Figurine Buyer
quests.description: Meshif's contacts in Kurast Bazaar are buying jade trinkets at a premium. Sell three jade artifacts to him for a tidy sum.

quests.name: Ormus's Charm
quests.description: Ormus, troubled by visions, asks you to slay corrupt fetish shamans deep in the Flayer Dungeon. He grants you a small enchanted charm in return.

quests.name: Tyrael's Blessing
quests.description: Having freed Izual's soul, Tyrael grants you an extra skill point and reflects upon Heaven's regret for the Fallen Angel.

quests.name: Jamella's Stockpile
quests.description: The angelic merchant Jamella will gladly trade rare gems for crafting reagents you collect from Hephasto's forge.

quests.name: Halbu's Soulwork
quests.description: Halbu, the angelic armorer, offers to socket a piece of armor for those who shattered Mephisto's soulstone.

quests.name: Larzuk's Hammer
quests.description: Larzuk the smith will socket one of your items as thanks for breaking Shenk's siege.

objectives.description: Bring an item to Larzuk to socket.

quests.name: Anya's Gift
quests.description: After her rescue, Anya gifts you a personalized scroll of resistances and unlocks her unique-item stock.

quests.name: Qual-Kehk's Warband
quests.description: Qual-Kehk offers Barbarian warriors to fight at your side after the freed prisoners return to Harrogath.

quests.name: Malah's Elixir
quests.description: Malah brews an elixir that permanently raises your vitality. Bring her ingredients from the Glacial Trail.

quests.name: Nihlathak's Treasure
quests.description: Cain suspects Nihlathak hid a relic in the Pit of Acheron deep within the Halls of Anguish. Recover it.
